description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may differ for each API request.
The ID of the network ACL.

description.zh:
网络ACL的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the network ACL.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
网络ACL所属的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the network ACL. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
The ID of the associated resource.

description.zh:
关联实例的类型。取值：**VSwitch**，交换机。

**ResourceType**和**ResourceId**参数需要同时指定才生效。
description.en:
The type of the associated resource. Valid values: **VSwitch**: vSwitch.

The **ResourceType** and **ResourceId** parameters must be specified together to take effect.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the VPC associated with the network ACL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-network-acls --network-acl-id nacl-bp1lhl0taikrbgnh0000 --network-acl-name acl-1 --vpc-id vpc-m5ebpc2xh64mqm27e0000 --resource-type VSwitch --resource-id vsw-bp1de348lntdwnhbg0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeNetworkAcls --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --NetworkAclId 'nacl-bp1lhl0taikrbgnh0000' --VpcId 'vpc-m5ebpc2xh64mqm27e0000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceId 'vsw-bp1de348lntdwnhbg0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --NetworkAclName 'acl-1' --ResourceType VSwitch --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
